goal: Verify that deterministic Roslyn compilation plus Unity BuildOptions.NoUniqueIdentifier and StrictMode produce repeatable exact Unity 2019.4.41f2 staged archives without weakening verification or protected-root guarantees.

diffReview.observed: Assets/csc.rsp contains exactly -deterministic; BuildPlayerOptions combines BuildOptions.NoUniqueIdentifier and BuildOptions.StrictMode; Unity imported and built this exact source twice.

unitySuccessMarkers: Batchmode quit successfully invoked - shutting down!

protectedRoots.canonicalProject: No scoped product change after builds; exact HEAD and tree retained. Unity-generated Library state is outside tracked product scope.
protectedRoots.productionPlayer: No promotion performed. The three production files read by the build script had identical before/after SHA-256 manifests; comparison exit 0. Worker full-root before/after manifests also have comparison exit 0.
protectedRoots.activeDataset: No command referenced or wrote the active dataset. Worker root-stat comparison exit is 0; the independent run did not recursively scan the multi-million-file active root.

adversarialClasses.stale_state: PASS: separate absent evidence-owned stages were used; build payload roots were fresh mktemp directories.
adversarialClasses.dirty_worktree: PASS: pre-existing .omo churn did not affect identical archives; repeated package tests covered tracked product rejection and passed twice.
adversarialClasses.misleading_success_output: PASS: success required process exits, exact SHA-256 equality, byte comparison, embedded provenance comparison, receipt comparison, and verifier JSON; wrong SHA produced no stdout and exited 1.
adversarialClasses.malformed_or_wrong_input: PASS: wrong expected SHA rejected with the exact mismatch diagnostic.
adversarialClasses.flaky_tests: PASS: focused suite passed twice and two full Unity builds were byte-identical.
adversarialClasses.hung_or_long_commands: PASS: both Unity builds and verifiers were bounded by TERM/KILL timeouts.
adversarialClasses.cancel_resume: NOT_APPLICABLE: deliberate interruption could corrupt shared Unity import state; bounded cancellation was installed and neither build hung.
adversarialClasses.live_runtime: NOT_RUN: static verification only; the assignment did not request starting the player or rebuilding/promoting the canonical stage.

slopAndProgrammingReview.production: The two production changes are minimal platform flags; no unnecessary extraction, parsing, normalization, broad error handling, dead code, or scope drift found.
slopAndProgrammingReview.tests: The source-parsing tests alone are implementation-adjacent and insufficient proof, but they are not the approval basis. Two real Unity builds, archive byte comparison, provenance comparison, receipt comparison, and real verifier execution independently prove the user-visible criterion.
